query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.station_id') AS workstation, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.primary_camera_id') AS primary_camera, ROUND(CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.dwell_duration_seconds') AS REAL), 1) AS dwell_seconds, ROUND(CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.dwell_duration_seconds') AS REAL) / 60.0, 2) AS session_minutes, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.clothing_color') AS clothing, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.session_status') AS status FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'WorkstationPresenceSession' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 25

fields.name: 👁️ Raw Multi-Camera Detection Stream & Overlap Feed

query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.camera_id') AS camera, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.class_name') AS detected_class, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.confidence') AS REAL) AS confidence, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.bbox_area') AS REAL) AS bbox_area, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.dominant_color') AS color FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'AppearedClass' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 30
